# apple_ci_build_runs (Data Source)

Lists the most recent Xcode Cloud builds of a workflow or a product, newest first, with their progress and result.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_ci_build_runs" "ci" {
  workflow_id = apple_ci_workflow.ci.id
  limit       = 5
}

output "latest_build_status" {
  value = try(data.apple_ci_build_runs.ci.build_runs[0].completion_status, null)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `limit` (Number) How many builds to list, up to 200. Defaults to 10.
- `product_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of a product. Set this or `workflow_id`.
- `workflow_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of a workflow. Set this or `product_id`.

### Read-Only

- `build_runs` (Attributes List) The builds. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--build_runs))

<a id="nestedatt--build_runs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `build_runs`

Read-Only:

- `cancel_reason` (String) Why the build was canceled: `AUTOMATICALLY_BY_NEWER_BUILD` or `MANUALLY_BY_USER`.
- `completion_status` (String) Result of a complete build: `SUCCEEDED`, `FAILED`, `ERRORED`, `CANCELED` or `SKIPPED`.
- `created_date` (String) When the build was created.
- `execution_progress` (String) Progress of the build: `PENDING`, `RUNNING` or `COMPLETE`.
- `finished_date` (String) When the build finished. Null until it does.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the build run.
- `is_pull_request_build` (Boolean) Whether the build is of a pull request.
- `number` (Number) Number of the build.
- `source_commit_sha` (String) Commit the build is of.
- `start_reason` (String) Why the build started, e.g. `GIT_REF_CHANGE`, `MANUAL` or `SCHEDULE`.
- `started_date` (String) When the build started. Null until it does.
